summary: Backend-only testing for Tina Voice (ElevenLabs) endpoints. All 9 pytest cases passed (100%): voice/status, voice/speak (success + 2x 400 validation), voice/transcribe (success + 2x 4xx validation), plus smoke checks for tina/welcome-back and tina/chat. TTS returns a valid MP3 (verified ID3 header, ~30KB+) wrapped in a data:audio/mpeg;base64 URI. STT round-trip (synthesize -> transcribe) returned non-empty text via Scribe v1.
action_items: (Optional) Update docstrings in /app/backend/tina_voice_service.py (lines 9, 28) and /app/backend/server.py line 3285 — they still reference 'Monika Sogam / Indian English female' but the active voice is now Sarah (EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL, American female) per Free-tier constraint. Functional behavior is correct; only comments are stale.
(Optional) Make /api/tina/voice/transcribe explicitly return 400 for an empty multipart file (currently bubbles up as 500 from ElevenLabs SDK).
critical_code_review_comments: tina_voice_service.py is clean and small (116 lines), uses lazy client init, defensive text trimming (800-char cap), and proper error propagation.

server.py voice endpoints (3277-3312) correctly use api_router with /api prefix, Pydantic model for /speak, UploadFile for /transcribe, and re-raise HTTPException before the generic 500 handler — good pattern.
Voice ID is correctly read from env (ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID=EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL = Sarah); no hardcoded override. Free-tier constraint respected.
seed_data_creation: No persistent data created. /api/tina/welcome-back and /api/tina/chat smoke tests used user_id='TEST_voice_user_001' (in-memory Tina session only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three /api/tina/voice/* endpoints are working end-to-end with the Free-tier ElevenLabs key and Sarah voice. The pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_tina_voice.py covers status, TTS (success + empty/whitespace 400), STT (round-trip via synthesized clip + missing-file + empty-file), and smokes welcome-back/chat. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tina_voice.py -v. Requires EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (sourced from /app/frontend/.env).
